title: Invocation Fidelity Bench: Tool Selection & Argument Validation Regression Suite
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a reproducible, automated benchmark that measures end-to-end invocation fidelity for tool/function calling across model and config changes. The harness will track two primary signal families: tool selection accuracy (did the model choose the correct tool(s) for a prompt) and argument validation fidelity (are the arguments structured, complete, and schema-compliant). This ticket covers dataset curation, evaluation runner, CI hooks for PRs and model rollouts, alerting thresholds, and dashboards for trend analysis.
acceptance_criteria: A stable evaluation harness executable in CI that runs on merge/model-rollout events
Canonical dataset of at least 4k labeled tool-invocation examples covering 12 tools and common failure modes
Metrics computed per-run: tool_selection_top1_accuracy, tool_selection_top3_recall, arg_schema_compliance_rate, arg_missing_rate, false_positive_tool_invocations
Regression detection rules: raise alert if top1_accuracy drops >2.5% absolute or arg_schema_compliance_rate drops >3% relative versus baseline
Dashboards in Console showing 90d trend with per-model and per-config breakdowns
PR gate: harness must pass for runtime or model config changes that affect tool invocation path or schema contract
tasks: Assemble and label dataset (4k examples) with metadata: prompt, ground_truth_tool_ids, expected_args_schema
Create evaluation runner that supports running against hosted and dedicated model variants (API + offline runner)
Implement metric calculations and output as JSON lines for ingestion
Wire CI webhook: run harness on PRs that touch runtime/tooling/config or on model rollouts
Build Console dashboard and alerting rule; add short summary widget for on-call email and Slack channel
Add canonical baselines for current release and store baselines in internal artifact repo
rollout_plan: Start with a canary that evaluates 10% of model rollouts and CI on all PRs touching /runtime or /tooling. If the harness detects regressions, block rollout and trigger automated bisect (model vs config) to identify offender. Post-mortem and remediation plan required before unblocking.
